title: TokenResponse
description: OAuth 2.0 token response containing the access token and associated metadata for authenticating subsequent API requests.

access_token.description: The bearer access token for authenticating API requests

expires_in.description: The lifetime of the access token in seconds

refresh_token.description: A non-expiring refresh token that can be used to obtain new access tokens without requiring re-authorization.

scope.description: Space-delimited list of scopes granted to the access token
